observation.visible_scene: A low-angle, ground-level view of a wet, reflective public splash-pad/fountain area. In the left foreground a person in blue jeans and blue-and-pink inline skates stands beside a pink child's tricycle, with a teal strap crossing the upper-left. A small water jet erupts from the pavement in the center foreground, with a second, warmer-lit jet just behind it. In the blurred mid-background stand a figure in a white shirt and black trousers and a figure in a dark shirt. On the right, an adult in dark trousers and brown leather shoes stands beside a small child in a white shirt and teal shorts, whose raised hands are held by an adult hand at the top-right edge.
visible_changes: The adult in dark trousers and brown shoes, initially standing with feet planted at the right (frames 1-9), begins striding leftward across the foreground; the legs open into a walking gait, brown shoe soles lift and rotate, and the body translates progressively left until the legs occupy the left half of the frame by the end (frames 10-41).

As the walking adult moves, a bare arm enters from the top/upper-left and reaches across to hold the child's hand (visible from about frame 24 onward); the child, previously standing upright at the right, tilts the torso, raises one arm, and lifts a leg, swinging/leaning as if being held and spun during the adult's leftward walk (frames 10-41).

The central fountain jet continuously changes shape and height frame to frame - alternately a bushy burst and a thin tall column with scattered droplets - while the secondary lit jet behind it also varies; this pulsing is ongoing throughout and is not triggered by anything visible.
The skater's legs, the pink tricycle, and the teal strap remain essentially in place with only minor postural shifts; the two blurred background figures also stay roughly put with small movements.
The wet ground reflections of the skates, legs and jets persist across all frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: What precedes the adult's standing pose and what follows the leftward walk/swing beyond the crop.
The cause or cycle of the fountain's pulsing.
Whether the child is being spun, swung, or merely held steady.
uncertain_details: The camera appears largely static (skater and tricycle hold constant frame positions), but slight residual motion cannot be fully excluded.
The relationship of the reaching bare arm to the walking adult is inferred from continuity, not directly shown as a single body.
Exact gait phase and the child's motion direction are sampled at discrete frames, so intermediate positions are approximate.
